description: A PHP class for managing application variables in the Revive Adserver project, including methods for getting, setting, deleting, and caching variables, as well as generating a platform hash.

classes.name: OA_Dal_ApplicationVariables
classes.description: A Data Access Layer class for handling application variables, including caching and hash generation.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieve the value of an application variable by name.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Set or update the value of an application variable.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Delete an application variable by name.

methods.name: cleanCache
methods.description: Reload variables from the database, clearing the cache.

methods.name: _getAll
methods.description: Private method to get a reference to the cache of all application variables, optionally reloading from the database.

methods.name: generatePlatformHash
methods.description: Generate a unique 40-character hexadecimal platform hash.
